work_unit.title: 同步 GitHub PR 正文归一化路由测试契约
work_unit.goal: 让 Connector 路由测试区分省略正文的外部请求和共享 schema 生成的规范化 Domain API 命令。

reason: The full Vitest gate stopped because the route test expected the raw body-less payload even though T014 intentionally normalizes an omitted pull-request body to the canonical empty string before Domain API dispatch.

rules: Preserve omission of params.body on the HTTP wire fixture.
Assert the normalized body passed to the Domain API.
Do not change product code or validator behavior.
